er_requirement: If a node receives a Packet Too Big message reporting a next-hop MTU less than the IPv6 minimum link MTU, it must discard it. A node must not reduce its estimate of the Path MTU below the IPv6 minimum link MTU on receipt of a Packet Too Big message.
